name: Birta
description:
Birta turns a conversation with Claude into a live, working website — a landing page, a service page, a small commercial site — and keeps it manageable afterwards. You describe the result you want, Claude builds and publishes the pages, and the site goes online at a real address. No servers, builds, or deploy pipelines to set up.

What you can do through the connector:

• Create and list projects, and rename an existing one.
• Work on a draft version of a site: create files, read and edit them in place, replace an exact fragment or a range of lines, move or delete files, and list everything before it goes live.
• Publish a draft to a real, shareable address — or roll a project back to an earlier published version if something goes wrong.
• Read the remarks left on a version, so feedback from a client or a teammate comes back into the same conversation.
• Declare lead forms on a site and read the leads that come in, without writing any backend code.
• Check a project's visitor stats.

Every published site gets its own address immediately. Custom domains, billing and account settings live in the Birta dashboard, which mirrors what the connector can do — dangerous, irreversible actions stay with you, not the agent.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Birta to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Birta to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://birta.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Birta MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Birta lists 24 MCP tools, including create_form, create_project, create_version, delete_file, delete_form, delete_version, edit_file, get_form, get_lead, list_files, list_forms, and list_leads.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Birta?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Birta in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Birta requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Birta is developed by SP Krou Tech. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
